case.summary: An investigation was triggered by a bank model risk score of 0.9 and a flagged transaction originating from a device marked new for the account. The decisive evidence was the customer confirming they made the transaction, along with the amount and product sitting within their normal range. It was assumed the customer made the transaction because no graph evidence beyond the alert pointed to fraud. The verdict is legitimate and actions follow Fraud Policy R3, which dictates that when a customer confirms the transaction, the case is recommended to be closed as no fraud and the confirmation noted.
